scope: One-button automatic OCR diagnostics; text-evidence routing and explicit review; no six-class visual weights

summary.limitation: Synthetic text-evidence acceptance cases; no real six-class labeled dataset or visual classifier. NOT a classification accuracy benchmark.

automaticRealOcrEvaluation.note: Expected labels unchanged. Four exact-field failures from recognition whitespace also occur with explicit profiles; water unit below evidence threshold yields safe unknown rather than ambiguous.

limitations: No real six-class held-out accuracy/confusion matrix or calibrated classification confidence
No real MinIO/Docker or 100-session workload evaluation in this change
Timing is sequential local service analysis and excludes camera/upload/model initialization
Synthetic text evidence is not validated visual object classification; meter display technology still requires manual selection
